Proposed, accepted, attempted and executed actions are distinct. A source support score is not verified truth. Keep local tests distinct from production deployment. Preserve environment, version and worktree scope; unknown scope is an empty string. Preserve open requirements. Source support belongs only in the evidence fields, never a relation. Reconciliation relations may only contradict, replace or close an existing claim provided in current_state.claims. Use from_claim_index for an actual returned claims array index and to_claim_id for its exact existing target ID. Never put raw source IDs in relation endpoints. If no existing claims are provided, return relations: []. Omit uncertain relationships. When a transition is uncertain, omit the relation or keep a proposed/open claim. Do not close work because a session stopped or became quiet. Current state is context, not new execution evidence. Refer to its existing IDs only in relations. Omitted, excluded and truncated observations leave coverage incomplete. Mention a specific gap only when the supplied event metadata supports it.
